metadata.title: Northline Bank delivery and credit components

components.title: Credit decisioning model service
components.description: Online service that scores a credit application and records the model version.

control-implementations.description: Model-service portion of the high-risk requirements.

implemented-requirements.description: The service refuses a promotion when the risk review is missing.
The service reads only data sets named in the model card.
The decision API exposes an interrupt used by the credit decision reviewer.
The service requires authenticated, encrypted access.

components.title: Payments and model delivery pipeline
components.description: CI/CD platform that builds, signs, and promotes payment and model releases.

control-implementations.description: Pipeline controls for the tier-1 delivery platform.

implemented-requirements.description: A production job requires a recorded peer approval.
The pipeline signs artifacts and blocks unsigned deploys.
The pipeline publishes an SBOM beside the signed artifact.
Jobs fetch secrets at runtime from the secrets service.
Dependency scan runs on every build and on the 7 day cadence.
Pipeline admin and deploy events are shipped to the audit log.
Privileged pipeline roles require a named approver.
A failed signed deploy opens an incident with an owner.

components.title: Secrets service
components.description: Approved store for application secrets and signing keys.

control-implementations.description: Key storage for signing and runtime secrets.

implemented-requirements.description: Signing keys cannot be exported to a developer workstation.
